checks.text: The page displays the heading "Gift List Tracker" and the text "No gifts yet".

Typing "Book" in the field labelled "Item", "Alice" in the field labelled "Recipient", "15" in the field labelled "Price", and clicking the button "Add gift" adds a row to the table with "Book", "Alice", "$15.00", and "Pending". The text "No gifts yet" disappears.
In the row for "Book", clicking the button "Mark purchased" changes the status cell to "Purchased" and the button label to "Mark pending".
Typing "Toy" in the field labelled "Item", "Bob" in the field labelled "Recipient", "20" in the field labelled "Price", and clicking "Add gift" adds a second row. The table now has two rows.
Clicking the filter chip labelled "Purchased" hides the row for "Toy" and shows only the row for "Book". Clicking the filter chip labelled "All" shows both rows again.
Typing "Alice" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row for "Book". Clearing the search box shows both rows.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" triggers a download of a file named "gifts.csv" containing the header "Item,Recipient,Price,Status" and the row "Book,Alice,15.00,Purchased".
In the row for "Book", clicking the button "Delete Book" removes the row. The table now shows only the row for "Toy".
Reload keeps the gift "Toy" for "Bob" with status "Pending" and price "$20.00" visible in the table.
